conditional_table_bank.candidate_tables: unique nondefault exact-oracle tables from training pairs only
conditional_table_bank.construction: deterministic forward greedy selection maximizing aggregate training bytes saved versus stock under best-of-bank plus stock fallback; table SHA-256 breaks ties
conditional_table_bank.deployment_prototype: only after the table-bank test is complete and the generality gate passed
conditional_table_bank.monotonic_fallback: for every pair emit the smallest of stock and every bank-table encoding
conditional_table_bank.test_metric: aggregate test bank savings / aggregate positive test oracle savings
conditional_table_bank.validation_choice: choose the smallest bank reaching aggregate validation oracle capture >=0.70; if none does, choose maximum validation capture, then smaller bank

distribution_analysis.balanced_means: project-balanced mean averages project means equally; category-balanced mean averages category means equally
distribution_analysis.change_distance: within each project/category baseline group, report near/medium/far values and Spearman correlation of ordinal distance 1/2/3 with savings
distribution_analysis.pair_summary: median, quartiles, mean, min, max, and threshold fractions

feature_definitions.entropy: base-2 Shannon entropy of empirical signature frequencies
feature_definitions.herfindahl: sum of squared empirical signature probabilities
feature_definitions.instruction_density: logical instruction count / target output MiB
feature_definitions.instruction_signature: TYPE:SIZE:MODE, with MODE=0 for ADD and RUN
feature_definitions.normalized_entropy: entropy/log2(number of positive-frequency signatures), or zero for <=1 signature
feature_definitions.oracle_saving_fraction: (stock patch bytes - exact oracle patch bytes) / stock patch bytes
feature_definitions.pair_signature: ordered adjacent instruction signatures within one window
feature_definitions.r_i: stock instruction-section bytes / stock patch bytes
feature_definitions.stock_only_rule: Predictor columns are computed from artifact sizes and the stock xdelta3 fixed logical trace. Oracle/table fields are labels only.
feature_definitions.table_transmission_cost: oracle file-header bytes - default file-header bytes
feature_definitions.top_k_mass: mass of the k most frequent signatures
feature_definitions.top_pair_coverage: For the k most frequent pair signatures, dynamic programming chooses a maximum-cardinality nonoverlapping set of their occurrences; divide the number of covered logical instructions by instruction count.

all_required.grouped_classifier: selected training grouped out-of-fold ROC AUC >=0.75
all_required.non_source_repetition: at least 2 compiled or structured pairs save >=1%
all_required.project_repetition: at least 3 confirmatory projects have >=1 pair saving >=1%

generality_gate.undefined_metric_rule: an undefined required metric fails its gate component

outcome_state: frozen before any confirmatory VCDIFF trace

predictive_protocol.model_selection: Regression minimizes grouped-CV MAE, tie-broken by higher Spearman then fixed listed order. Classification maximizes grouped out-of-fold ROC AUC, tie-broken by average precision then fixed listed order.

regressors.instruction_fraction_linear: ordinary least squares on r_i only

predictive_protocol.standardization: fit median imputation and standardization inside each training fold
predictive_protocol.test_rule: After model and threshold are fixed on train/validation, evaluate test projects once.
predictive_protocol.training_cv: LeaveOneGroupOut by project on training projects
predictive_protocol.validation_threshold: Among unique predicted probabilities plus endpoints, choose the threshold with precision >=0.70 that maximizes recall, then precision, then threshold.
